settings.heading: Disc Trac helical LSD
settings.text: Ultimate traction from a 7 helical gear limited slip differential, built inside a forged 2MNCR5 casing and hardened for the track.

The Disc Trac helical LSD is engineered to deliver superior performance on the track. A 7 helical gear system drives smooth, seamless power to both wheels for maximum traction and stability, while a patented power transfer mechanism keeps power losses low so you hold speed and control through corners. The forged 2MNCR5 casing is hardened between 45 and 50 HRC, so the unit stands up to extreme loads and keeps performing lap after lap.

settings.heading: Three parts, one seamless unit
settings.text: Every Disc Trac is designed around adjustability, strength and smooth engagement.

settings.title: Customisable disc preload
settings.text: A variable disc preload system lets you fine tune how aggressively the diff engages. Run it tighter for high speed grip or looser for smoother transitions, so the LSD suits your driving style and the track on the day.

settings.title: Forged external casing
settings.text: The casing is forged from 2MNCR5 steel, then precision CNC machined and hardened. It resists deformation under high torque, sheds heat well, and is designed to drop into a range of differential housings for a straightforward fit.

settings.title: 7 helical gear internals
settings.text: The 7 helical gear set gives progressive, smooth engagement with no harsh locking. Paired with strategic friction surfaces for a balanced 50/50 torque split, it runs quietly and needs far less maintenance than a clutch type LSD.

settings.heading: Built to a spec, not a price
settings.text: Race grade materials and tolerances in every unit.
